secrets_vault.name: Secrets vault
secrets_vault.desc: Keeps API keys, passwords and tokens encrypted on the phone.
secrets_vault.help: All entries live in one file (~/.aio/vault.json), encrypted with AES-256-GCM. The key is derived from your master password (scrypt), which makes guessing very slow, and any change to the file is detected. Values are typed hidden and only shown on request; with Termux:API (pkg install termux-api) they can be copied straight to the clipboard. Important: the master password cannot be recovered. Needs the cryptography package (pkg install python-cryptography).
secrets_vault.need_crypto: The Python package cryptography is missing. In Termux: pkg install python-cryptography (otherwise: pip install cryptography).
secrets_vault.new_password: New master password (at least {min} characters, Enter = cancel):
secrets_vault.too_short: Too short, please use at least {min} characters.
secrets_vault.create_intro: There is no vault yet. Choose a master password. It cannot be recovered, so keep it safe.
secrets_vault.no_clipboard: Copying needs Termux:API (the app and pkg install termux-api). Use "Show".
